insight: Take Lightning Storm first in mid lane to secure CS. It provides mana sustain through the Chronic Nourishment facet, which outweighs the nerf to Diabolic Edict facet for early game farming and jungling efficiency.

Disrupt enemy CS by controlling creep positioning and making random attacks on creeps to mess with their farming rhythm. Avoid all-ins after enemy reaches level 6 if they can steal your spells effectively.

Prioritize Mana Boots over Ring of Basilius. Consider swapping to Treads late for attack speed scaling with Chronic Nourishment facet. Buy Raindrop against heavy spell damage instead of early mana items.
Master double camp stacking and pulling together. Use Lightning Storm to hit all creeps and maximize mana generation. Time right-clicks to maintain creep aggro as you rotate between camps.
After level 6, abandon mid lane if enemy mid and supports can effectively counter your hero. Prioritize efficient jungle farming over staying in lane when risk-reward favors jungling.
Use Diabolic Edict facet for early tower damage only if enemy team lacks push defense. In matchups with strong anti-push (Jakiro, Hoodwink), use Chronic Nourishment facet instead for farm efficiency.
When returning to base, estimate travel time before stacking camps. Missing creep waves to stack is often not worth the tradeoff. Only stack if you have guaranteed time to clear before lane push.

Buy Black King Bar before Blink Dagger to survive burst. After Black King Bar, Aghanim's Scepter is valuable against physical damage cores as it makes nearby enemies ethereal, preventing non-Black King Bar users from hitting you.

Farm towards crucial item timings (Kaya, Blink, Black King Bar) even in stompy games. Each item significantly impacts survivability and damage output. Communicate timings to team and avoid fights until you finish critical items.
Position near your save support (Dazzle) when possible. Blink away from threats rather than toward teammates if you lack escape. Your role is to draw attention and output damage while staying alive.
Scan defensively when enemy heroes are missing from lanes. Track when enemies take runes and objectives to predict rotations. This allows you to farm safely or adjust positioning preemptively.
Reset your mental assessment of the matchup when enemy support rotates to your lane. Don't maintain 'pressure mode' after losing CS to rotations—recalibrate expectations and shift to farming mode.

Communicate item timings to team before fights. Tell teammates to wait for your crucial items rather than forcing early fights. This allows you to have maximum impact rather than fighting without key survivability or damage items.
Don't farm double camps when you have immediate map objectives. Prioritize waves, towers, or runes if your team needs presence. Only use double camps when you have no time-sensitive responsibilities.

Set expectations at draft based on team composition. With low playmaking potential (three ranged cores, no stuns), commit to farming efficiently rather than forcing unneeded fights. This prevents tilt from 'nothing happening.'

Stay composed when teammates make mistakes. A single death or lost pick doesn't decide the game. Stay calm and continue executing your game plan—many stompy games are lost purely due to lack of team composure.

Don't commit to every fight your team initiates when you're farming toward crucial timings. Communicate that you're finishing items and will join when ready. Defend waves and towers to prevent losses while farming.
